verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Statsig publishes API reference pages describing endpoints, such as checking feature gates and logging custom events. Nothing shows those pages are interactive or offer runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. A static reference is an adjacent capability, not the interactive, runnable reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
